label: TP-Link EAP615-Wall
description: AX1800 wall-plate Wi-Fi 6 access point: one gigabit uplink (PoE in), three gigabit downlinks with PoE passthrough on one, dual-band 802.11ax.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: uplink 1x 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port, downlink 3x 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet ports (one supporting PoE out); IEEE 802.11ax/ac/n/g/b/a; 802.3af/at PoE input. Modelled as AX1800 - 574M on 2.4 GHz and 1.2G on 5 GHz - which is the 2x2 Wi-Fi 6 split for that class.
